text: What did Lego do with that time? Instead of chasing growth, it went back to basics. It stopped trying to be everything and asked what it was really for. In 2005 it sold its four Legoland theme parks for 375 million euros, to focus on its core toys. The parks were not a failure, but they were not the brick.
